hypothesis: When XAUUSD has already moved an abnormal volatility-scaled distance during its executable Ostium session, price discovery can continue in the same direction into the late session.
falsifier: Reject before StrategyQuant unless a connected train region remains profitable after 8/15/30 bps, exact 200-USDC sizing, year stability and zero simulated liquidations.
independence: New campaign and finite grid. No quantitative output, thresholds, candidates or performance from previous Alquimia campaigns are inputs. Existing loaders, M15 parity evidence and accounting conventions are technical infrastructure only.

external_evidence.source: Caporale and Plastun (2021), Gold and oil prices: abnormal returns, momentum and contrarian effects
external_evidence.usable_claim: Same-day momentum after abnormal gold moves was reported over 2009-2020.
limitations: MetaQuotes hourly data in GMT+3, not Dukascopy or Ostium
timing parameters and expected hourly returns were estimated over the full sample
trading simulation omitted spreads, fees and swaps
no walk-forward, StrategyQuant robustness or 200-USDC liquidation model

session.anchor: first complete M15 bar at 18:15 after the 16:59-18:10 Ostium closure
session.reason: DST-aware venue clock; exit precedes the 16:59 daily closure

signal.current_partial_return: 18:15 previous session through detection-time M15 open
signal.threshold: rolling mean completed-session return plus/minus k times sample standard deviation, using only prior completed sessions
signal.direction: continuation: long above upper threshold, short below lower threshold

execution.entry: M15 open at the frozen detection time after signal calculation from earlier bars
execution.exit: protective stop or 16:45 America/New_York M15 open
execution.intrabar_policy: gap liquidation, gap stop, then stop before time exit
